stem: Which sequence best supports a canopy maintenance work order?
choices: Confirm room/batch and task scope, sanitize tools, complete the specified work consistently, note exceptions/damage, then reconcile the work record
Begin cutting before checking plant identity
Use the same uncleaned tool through all rooms
Complete the work from memory and document only if something goes wrong
rationale: Controlled canopy work depends on correct identity/scope, sanitation, consistent execution, and complete records.
